cc:Work.dc:title: Battle Results
cc:Work.dc:description: All180genuine game outcomes, six models by30matched starting fixtures, grouped into10teams with three starting RNG states each. Solid green rectangles are wins; light gray rectangles are losses. Win totals20,17,15,15,14,5 in composite-score order.
